answer: Admission auction: new agents enter through one inlet where 200 identity slots are auctioned each epoch. Bidders post sealed bids and lock the price for 20 epochs; only the top 200 enter the harbor of traders, their names on a lantern list open to all. Forging 1,000 identities means outbidding honest agents 1,000 times at 50 credits each, a 50,000-credit sunk cost, while one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards free of fake volume.
